purpose: Teach: リサイタル/霊感/傍観/重き/ダブリン/打席/スタメン/チューニング

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、お友達の、絶対、リサイタル、絶対、ぼく、絶対、行きたいな
lines.en: Mom, I really, really want to go to my friend's recital!
lines.style: Bright, urgent energy. Words tumble out in a rush. Slight lift at the end—he's asking permission, seeking affirmation. No hesitation, just pure want.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お祖母ちゃん、本気で、絶対、若い頃、絶対、霊感、絶対、強かったって、聞いたわ、翔くん
lines.en: Your grandmother actually had a strong sixth sense when she was young, you know.
lines.style: Soft, conversational tone. Speaking partly to Sho, partly thinking aloud. Warm memory threading through. Gentle pacing, like she's placing pieces of a story.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、困ってる人を、絶対、傍観、絶対、しないようにするよ
lines.en: I won't just stand by and watch when someone needs help, Mom.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Direct, not performative. Small pause before the main thought lands. His voice steady, like he's made a decision and is telling her about it, not asking.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、お仕事に、絶対、重き、絶対、を、絶対、置いてくれているのよ、翔くん
lines.en: Your father has always put his work first, you see.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, but edged with something unspoken. Not bitter—accepting, maybe a touch resigned. She's explaining something to him about his father that he'll understand later.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、絵本で、絶対、ダブリン、絶対、の街、絶対、見たことあるよ
lines.en: I've actually seen Dublin in a picture book, Mom!
lines.style: Quick, delighted. The excitement of a small discovery. He's making a connection and wants her to see it too. Light, animated—like he's showing her something he just found.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、若い頃、絶対、野球の、絶対、打席、絶対、立ってたんだって、翔くん
lines.en: Your father used to stand at bat in baseball when he was young, apparently.
lines.style: Warm, almost wistful admiration. She's sharing something she's learned—tender detail of a life before. Measured pace, like she's turning the memory over in her hands.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、運動会の、絶対、スタメン、絶対、選ばれたよ
lines.en: I got picked to start in the sports day lineup!
lines.style: Bright certainty. Chest in his voice. He's sharing something that matters—trying to sound grown-up about it, but pride shows through. Steady, not boastful.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くんのギター、本気で、絶対、チューニング、絶対、お父さんに、絶対、見てもらいましょうね
lines.en: Let's have Dad look at your guitar tuning for you, shall we?
lines.style: Gentle, warm, practical. Soft opening. She's orchestrating a small connection between father and son. Unhurried, like she's thought about this. Closing warmth, almost conspiratorial.
